title: Memory and Variables
summary: Nine variables (A–F, X, Y, M), Ans chaining, and independent M+/M− memory.

body.text: Store with SHIFT RCL (STO) then a variable key. Recall with RCL or embed with ALPHA + variable.
M+ adds display to M; SHIFT M+ (M−) subtracts. Indicator M shows when M ≠ 0.
Last result is Ans. Starting the next line with an operator continues from Ans automatically.
